description: Header file defining the TensorBase class in PyTorch's ATen library, including its interface, member functions, and related utilities. It aims to reduce header dependencies and improve build times by providing a lightweight handle to TensorImpl.

classes.name: TensorBase
classes.description: A lightweight, reference-counted handle to TensorImpl, designed to reduce header dependencies and improve build times in PyTorch.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the storage offset of the tensor.

methods.name: contiguous
methods.description: Returns a contiguous copy of the tensor with specified memory format.

methods.name: expect_contiguous
methods.description: Returns a MaybeOwned reference to a contiguous tensor, optimized to avoid reference count changes.

methods.name: fill_
methods.description: Fills the tensor with a scalar value.

methods.name: zero_
methods.description: Zeros out the tensor.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Converts tensor to specified options.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the tensor in a given dimension.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of the tensor in a given dimension.

methods.name: unsafeGetTensorImpl
methods.description: Returns a raw pointer to the underlying TensorImpl.

methods.name: defined
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is initialized.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the tensor, releasing its resources.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is contiguous in memory.

methods.name: nbytes
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes the tensor consumes.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: scalar_type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device on which the tensor is stored.

methods.name: is_cpu
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is on CPU.

methods.name: is_cuda
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is on CUDA.

methods.name: share_memory_
methods.description: Shares tensor memory across processes.

methods.name: is_sparse
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is sparse.

methods.name: is_mkldnn
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is MKL-DNN.

methods.name: has_names
methods.description: Checks if tensor has dimension names.

methods.name: get_named_tensor_meta
methods.description: Returns the tensor's named metadata.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns tensor options (dtype, device, layout).

methods.name: const_data_ptr
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to tensor data.

methods.name: mutable_data_ptr
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to tensor data.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints tensor information.

methods.name: accessor
methods.description: Returns a TensorAccessor for CPU tensors.

methods.name: register_hook
methods.description: Registers a backward hook for autograd.

methods.name: is_leaf
methods.description: Checks if tensor is a leaf in autograd graph.

methods.name: grad_fn
methods.description: Returns the gradient function node.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Returns a tensor detached from autograd graph.

methods.name: requires_grad
methods.description: Checks if tensor requires gradient.

methods.name: set_requires_grad
methods.description: Sets whether tensor requires gradient.
